brief:
Chinese President Xi Jinping and Egyptian President Abdel Fattah el-Sisi stated in a joint statement that the Palestinian question remains at the core of Middle East issues, Middle East Eye reported. The two leaders said the Palestinian cause is fundamental to understanding regional conflicts and international engagement in the area.

The joint statement signals shared positioning between Cairo and Beijing on the Israeli-Palestinian conflict. Both nations have historically maintained that resolving the Palestinian question is essential to achieving broader stability across the Middle East. The statement comes as China has expanded its diplomatic footprint in the region through economic initiatives and mediation efforts, while Egypt maintains its role as a key regional player and mediator in Israeli-Palestinian affairs.
dek: Joint Egyptian-Chinese statement: Palestinian cause is central in Middle East Chinese President Xi Jinping and Egyptian President Abdel Fattah el-Sisi reiterated that the Palestinian question remains at the core of the Middle East issue in a joint statement…
title: Egypt and China declare Palestinian cause central to Middle East
